description: This file contains internal class and structure definitions for the FreeType font rendering library, including validation, character maps, face and slot internal structures, module and driver classes, and library management functions.

classes.name: FT_ValidatorRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a validation object for font tables.

classes.name: FT_Face_InternalRec_
classes.description: Internal fields of an FT_Face object, including transformation matrices and services.

classes.name: FT_Slot_InternalRec_
classes.description: Internal fields of an FT_GlyphSlot object, including glyph loader and hints.

classes.name: FT_ModuleRec_
classes.description: Represents a module object instance in FreeType.

classes.name: FT_DriverRec_
classes.description: Root font driver class managing font files of a specific format.

classes.name: FT_LibraryRec_
classes.description: Root object managing the FreeType library state, modules, renderers, and memory.

classes.name: FT_RendererRec_
classes.description: Renderer object responsible for glyph rendering.

methods.name: ft_validator_init
methods.description: Initializes a font table validator with base address, limit, and validation level.

methods.name: ft_validator_run
methods.description: Runs validation on a font table.

methods.name: ft_validator_error
methods.description: Sets an error in the validator and performs a long jump.

methods.name: FT_Get_Module_Interface
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interface from a module by name.

methods.name: ft_module_get_service
methods.description: Gets a service interface from a module.

methods.name: FT_New_GlyphSlot
methods.description: Creates a new glyph slot for a face.

methods.name: ft_glyphslot_free_bitmap
methods.description: Frees the bitmap buffer of a glyph slot.

methods.name: ft_glyphslot_alloc_bitmap
methods.description: Allocates a bitmap buffer for a glyph slot.

methods.name: ft_glyphslot_set_bitmap
methods.description: Sets the bitmap buffer in a glyph slot to a specific pointer.

methods.name: FT_Lookup_Renderer
methods.description: Finds a renderer for a given glyph format.

methods.name: FT_Render_Glyph_Internal
methods.description: Renders a glyph slot with a specified render mode.
